Preserve input state immutability and freeze outer response container

clarifications: Task scope is strictly 5 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic authorization is FALSE (zero semantic files modified; canonical semantics established in T-023).
G-042 guardrails authorization is FALSE (zero guardrails modified).
Human Design Decision: Use one compound pure Domain operation with a dedicated immutable result type named AmmoDepletionResponse and function named resolveAmmoDepletionResponse.
Preconditions: Calling resolveAmmoDepletionResponse when currentWeaponAction.action !== FIRING or currentPosture.posture !== EXPOSED throws Error. No inactive-trigger no-op behavior.
Ammo boundary: MagazineAmmoState is not passed, inspected, or validated. Ammo decrement/mutation is deferred.
Squad Posture Intent boundary: SquadPostureIntent is not passed, inspected, or mutated.
Reload boundary: Result weapon action is IDLE; reload does not start during TRANSITIONING_TO_COVERED.

Authority boundary: Post-depletion IDLE denotes strictly that no active FIRING or RELOADING weapon action is in progress; it does NOT imply firing permission, ammo availability, ammo > 0, absence of STUN, CharacterPosture.EXPOSED, satisfaction of firing posture prerequisites, global character actionability, or reload eligibility.
Historical T-000 through T-023 records and events are preserved without modification.
